tools.description: JavaScript-based load testing with built-in metrics and cloud-native integrations
tools.usage:
k6 run --vus 100 --duration 30s script.js # Ramp load testing
k6 run --out influxdb=http://localhost:8086/k6 test.js # Real-time metrics
echo 'import http from "k6/http"; export default () => http.get("https://api.com");' | k6 run -
k6 run --summary-export=report.json load-test.js
